comments.body: STORY 0289 BLOCKED at plan-review claim gate: 7 critical findings, two design flaws. (A) merge=union is forbidden in this codebase (init.py: line-unions JSON into invalid JSON) — remediable (uuid-named event dirs never collide -> plain multi-parent merge is lossless; .bridge_state/* already merge=ours). (B) PREMISE-LEVEL (no suggested fix): git-remote-s3 exposes NO S3-object API for the DOCTOR lock marker / bundle enumeration / bundle deletion the heal needs, and AC line 6 forbids the direct boto3 SDK that would be required. Recommended pivot: optional s3_doctor.py uses boto3 directly (transitive via git-remote-s3 => no core dep) — reverses the story's helper-routing premise, so surfaced for a design decision, not a unilateral rewrite. STOPPING per skill's 'ticket is wrong -> report blocked' path. DONE this run: 2b05 (merged 1b19b8b, closed), 8970 (changes 1537->9eca7be153 + 1539->ea6994d7c6 both merged LLM-Review+1/Verified+1, closed; a critical plan-review-close finding — push_after_commit swallowing the S3 fail-closed error — was caught, RED-tested, fixed, and landed as 1539).
